instruction: Configure VLC to save video snapshots to the Desktop folder instead of the default Pictures folder

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC snapshot directory setting. Steps: 1) Open VLC preferences (Tools->Preferences->Show settings: All), 2) Navigate to Video->Filters->Scene filter settings or Video section, 3) Change snapshot-path to /home/user/Desktop. Evaluator reads VLC config file (vlcrc) and checks if snapshot-path is set to Desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts snapshot-path setting from VLC config file (/home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc)
Metric correctly compares extracted path with expected Desktop directory using exact string match
Expected value (/home/user/Desktop) semantically matches instruction requirement
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
Correct parameter handling: metric uses expected.get('directory') since expected IS the rules dict when type='rule'
No postconfig needed: getter reads from persistent config file on disk
Default fallback logic correct: returns /home/user/Pictures when snapshot-path not found
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider normalizing paths (strip trailing slashes, resolve symlinks) before comparison to handle edge cases, though current implementation should work for standard use cases
